scoring_justification: Recompute from raw DFT outputs in the checker sandbox is impossible; compare reported relative energies to paper gold within ±5 kJ/mol tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold relative energies for all stationary points and the SiNC→SiCN barrier from the original paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the published paper (the reference solution writes these known constants).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported values from the paper's main result, verified against the text.

outputs.description: Stationary-point energies for ICN and INC adsorption on the Si(100)-(2x1) single-dimer cluster at B3LYP/LanL2DZ+6-31G*. Contains 11 rows covering all minima and transition states from the paper's potential-energy diagram.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each reported relative_energy_kJmol to gold reference values (derived from the original paper) and also verifies that the SiNC→SiCN barrier computed as TS4_relative minus SiNC_relative matches the paper's value within an appropriate tolerance.

steps.note: Barrier SiNC→TS4 computed as TS4_relative − SiNC_relative
